summary: Iteration 13 — Frontend-only verification of SoundMap REDESIGN Phase 4 Compare Hub at /compare. All 8 review scenarios PASS (9/9 assertions PASS after adjusting for CSS text-transform: uppercase which Playwright's innerText renders literally). (1) EMPTY STATE: cleared localStorage → /compare shows whisper header 'COMPARE A / B', title 'Necesitás dos escenas', muted body, CTA 'Ir a Escenas' (data-testid='compare-empty-cta') with Layers + arrow icons. Zero .glass-card / ScreenShell legacy nodes. (2) POPULATED — pickers: after seeding two scenes via localStorage['soundmap-store'], /compare renders title 'Diff físico entre escenas', two scene pickers labelled A (sage #5BA777) and B (amethyst #9B7EBD) side-by-side with data-testid='picker-a' and 'picker-b', swap button in between (data-testid='compare-swap-btn'). Preselected to scenes[0] and scenes[1] (Alpha Warehouse / Bravo Warehouse). (3) PICKER DROPDOWN: clicking picker-a opens a dropdown with 2 options (data-testid='picker-option-scene-A' and '-scene-B'); selecting an option updates the picker chip name+room correctly. (4) HEATMAP HEROES: compare-spl-grids wrapper contains compare-grid-a and compare-grid-b, each with SVG heatmap and 3 MicroStats (Uniformidad 42%, Media 127.2 dB, Máx 145.2 dB for A; 29%, 123.7 dB, 139.3 dB for B) inside cards with quiet #0F1012 background. (5) DELTA BAND: compare-grid-delta renders with heading 'Delta · A menos B', diverging heatmap (data-testid='compare-delta-heatmap') showing proper +/- coloring (teal/blue for B stronger, orange for A stronger), legend chips 'B más fuerte' + 'A más fuerte' with colored dots, 3 DeltaStat blocks (Máxima diferencia +6.3 dB, Mínima diferencia -1.6 dB, Media +3.4 dB with 'Spread 7.9 dB' hint). (6) KEY METRICS: compare-key-metrics container shows 4 MetricPair blocks (Uniformidad SPL 42 vs 29 · A gana, Spread SPL 24.4 vs 23.5 · B gana, Speech score 72 vs 78 · B gana, Music score 81 vs 75 · A gana) with correct hue application (winner in A_HUE or B_HUE, loser neutral). (7) PROGRESSIVE DISCLOSURE: compare-toggle-details reads 'Ver detalles' initially, panel not in DOM. Clicking expands compare-details-panel with three sections — Recinto (4 DiffRow: Capacidad/Largo/Ancho/Alto), Acústica (5 DiffRow: Volumen/RT60/Distancia crítica/Speech/Music), Equipamiento (gear-diff-tops '4→6', gear-diff-subs '4→2', gear-diff-monitors '2→4', gear-diff-amps '2→1' with animated bars + totals '12→13 (+1)'). Toggling again collapses (button label switches to 'Ocultar detalles' / rotates chevron). (8) SWAP: clicking compare-swap-btn exchanges A↔B contents (Alpha/Bravo swap positions), heatmap heroes re-render accordingly. (9) LOAD A / LOAD B: compare-load-a with sage bg + 'Cargar A · Alpha Warehouse' label navigates to '/' and loads scene into store (verified via localStorage['soundmap-store'].state.room.name === 'Alpha Room'); compare-load-b with amethyst bg does the same for scene B. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors throughout. Design impression is fully aligned with /design and /perform — minimal chrome, typography-first, Apple/Linear/Arc aesthetic honored, no permanent sidebar on /compare. Spanish throughout. All test-ids kebab-case.
critical_code_review_comments: src/pages/compare/index.tsx L109-120: gridA / gridB useMemo return null when sceneToSources yields 0 sources — the HeatmapHero then falls through to a 'Sin equipo cargado' placeholder. That's correct UX, but the KEY METRICS block still consumes `gridA?.uniformityPct ?? null` and MetricPair renders '—'. Consider gating the entire delta+metrics block on `gridA && gridB` so an empty-gear scene doesn't leave a bare metrics section with 2×'—' next to 2 populated values (currently only 'Uniformidad SPL' and 'Spread SPL' rely on grids; Speech/Music always render from acoustics — that inconsistency is subtle).

src/pages/compare/index.tsx L122-127: `canShowDelta` gates by absolute Δlength <5m AND Δwidth <5m. Two rooms with e.g. 20×10 vs 21×20 would trigger canShowDelta=false → the fallback text 'Los recintos tienen dimensiones muy distintas…' renders (data-testid='compare-delta-nope'). Good defensive UX, but the 5m threshold is a hard-coded magic constant — consider hoisting to a named const (DELTA_MAX_ROOM_DIFF_M = 5) for future tuning.

src/pages/compare/index.tsx L134-139: `handleLoad` calls `loadScene(scene.clientId ?? scene.id)` then unconditionally `navigate('/')`. If the user is comparing scenes and hits Cargar A they lose the comparison context with no way to return — consider a subtle 'Volver a comparar' breadcrumb on the target route, or open the load in a new tab / preserve compare state.

src/pages/compare/index.tsx L697-731: DiffRow's `better` computation uses `higherIsBetter` — but the RoomDiff caller (L655-671) doesn't pass higherIsBetter, so all room-diff rows render with `better === null` and both A/B numbers stay in neutral F4F5F7. That's intentional (bigger room isn't strictly 'better') but the TrendingUp/TrendingDown icon still renders in AMETHYST (#9B7EBD) for delta > 0 (see L720-721 default), which visually implies B is 'winning' the size race. Consider either: (a) drop the icon color when `better === null`, or (b) always use a neutral muted color for RoomDiff rows.

src/pages/compare/index.tsx L738-740: GearDiff includes 'mics' in the category list but the grid template `grid-cols-[80px_1fr_40px_40px_1fr]` and the sample seed both had 0 mics — the row is correctly skipped via the `if (ca === 0 && cb === 0) return null;` guard. However totalGearCount (L26) intentionally excludes mics ('tops+subs+monitors+amps') while the visual list includes mics when non-zero — that creates an inconsistency where the header '12 → 13 (+1)' total might not match the sum of the visible bars if mics are present. Minor but potentially confusing on comparisons that include mic bags.

src/pages/compare/index.tsx L482: the fixed overlay `<div className='fixed inset-0 z-30' onClick={() => setOpen(false)} />` closes the picker dropdown but does NOT preventDefault/stopPropagation — clicking to close on the delta heatmap or other interactive area would still trigger both. Not a bug in current interactions but worth pointing out for future clickable-inside-map features.

Positive observation — parallel-symmetry with /design and /perform: /compare correctly reuses the whisper-header + big-title + muted body pattern (L157-169 and L195-207 mirror /design-hub L~30-60 and /perform-hub L~30-60). The 'compare-hub-title' data-testid pairs with 'design-hub-title' and 'perform-hub-title' — the trio is consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 9/9 assertions PASS across all 8 review scenarios.

test_credentials: N/A — anonymous local mode (Convex offline). No /app/memory/test_credentials.md required.
seed_data_creation: Seeded two scenes ('Alpha Warehouse' 32×22×6 m and 'Bravo Warehouse' 30×20×6 m — deliberately <5m diff to trigger delta band) into localStorage['soundmap-store'] under key 'state.scenes' with version=2. Each scene includes room, acoustics (manually computed plausible values matching AcousticsResult shape), tops (JBL SRX906LA), subs (QSC KLA181), monitors, dspUnits, amps to feed sceneToSources() → computeSplGrid(). No API mocking required — Convex is offline in preview and the store's localStorage persist middleware carries state directly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://soundmap-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. To test /compare populated state, seed localStorage BEFORE navigating: `localStorage.setItem('soundmap-store', JSON.stringify(SEED))` where SEED = {state:{scenes:[sceneA,sceneB],...},version:2}. Scenes need `room`, `acoustics` (full AcousticsResult shape from src/lib/audio/acoustics.ts), and at least one `tops`/`subs` entry so sceneToSources produces sources for the heatmap. IMPORTANT: Playwright's `inner_text()` respects CSS text-transform: uppercase — labels like 'Uniformidad', 'Media', 'Máx', 'Máxima diferencia' render as 'UNIFORMIDAD'/'MÁXIMA DIFERENCIA' via innerText. Use `element.evaluate('el => el.textContent')` to get the raw source case if asserting on labels. For A/B rooms with <5m dimensional diff → compare-grid-delta + compare-delta-heatmap render; otherwise compare-delta-nope fallback text appears. Iteration 13 (Compare Hub) PASSES cleanly — the redesign is production-ready. Remaining Phase 4 work per iteration_12 note: /library (Scenes + Templates + Community) and possibly /analyze consolidation.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Compare Hub Phase 4 implementation matches the review spec 1:1. All 8 review scenarios PASS on the first seed run. The 7 code-review comments above are all polish-level nits (magic 5m threshold, DiffRow icon color when better===null, mic exclusion inconsistency, loss of compare context on Cargar A/B, missing preventDefault on dropdown overlay). The redesign passes UAT as-is with premium Apple/Linear/Arc aesthetic honored.
